items.title: James Lincoln Collier interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2007
items.q: Because Milt Fillius had given a bunch of those things.

ctx.x: That’s right. Because Milt Fillius had given a bunch of those things. I forget that an album originally meant multiple records.

It was an album. These albums originally developed for classical music because if you wanted to have an opera, even on a twelve inch record, a twelve inch record is only going to play four and a half minutes of music on each side, nine minutes — if you’ve got an opera how many records are you going to need?
